title: Avoidability of Digraphs with Height Functions and Orientations of $C_4$
summary: A digraph $F$ is avoidable if, for every positive integer $k$, there exists an integer $d$ such that every digraph of minimum out-degree at least $d$ contains an $F$-free subdigraph of minimum out-degree at least $k$. We prove that no digraph admitting a height function is avoidable, where a height function increases by one along every arc. This answers a question of Christoph, Janzer, Petrova, and Steiner and, together with an additional avoidance argument, determines which orientations of $C_4$ are avoidable.
